description: A deferred, non-modal label anchored to a trigger (hover / focus). A flat bubble with a pointer arrow, in two tones — a high-contrast dark bubble (default) or a surface-coloured one (inverted).

props.name: children
props.description: The tooltips (and other markup) that share this Provider's timings.

props.name: delayDuration
props.description:
How long, in milliseconds, a pointer must rest on a trigger before the
tooltip opens on hover. Focus always opens immediately regardless of this.
Overridable per tooltip via {@link TooltipRootProps.delayDuration}.

props.name: skipDelayDuration
props.description:
The grace window, in milliseconds, after a tooltip in this group closes
during which hovering *another* trigger in the same Provider opens it
instantly (no `delayDuration` wait). Rest longer than this and the next
hover pays the full delay again.

props.name: children
props.description:
The tooltip's {@link TooltipTriggerProps`Tooltip.Trigger`},
{@link TooltipContentProps`Tooltip.Content`} (usually inside a
{@link TooltipPortalProps`Tooltip.Portal`}), and optional
{@link TooltipArrowProps`Tooltip.Arrow`}.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
Whether the tooltip is open on first render. The component owns the flag
from then on (hover/focus/blur/Escape drive it internally).
Forbidden in controlled mode — use `open` instead.

props.name: delayDuration
props.description:
Overrides {@link TooltipProviderProps.delayDuration} for this tooltip only
— the hover open delay in milliseconds. Falls back to the Provider's value
when omitted.

props.name: disableHoverableContent
props.description:
When `true`, removes the pointer-leave grace period: the tooltip closes the
instant the pointer leaves the trigger, so the user cannot move into the
content. Leave `false` for tooltips whose content is meant to be hovered.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description:
Called with the new open state after every transition. Optional in
uncontrolled mode; use it to observe (not drive) open/close.
Called with the requested open state whenever the tooltip wants to open
or close. Optional even in controlled mode.

props.name: open
props.description:
Forbidden in uncontrolled mode — use `defaultOpen` instead.
The current open state. The delay and grace timers still run and call
`onOpenChange`, but the tooltip only moves when the parent updates this.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render the single child element (a link, icon button, etc.) instead of the
default `<button>`, merging the trigger's ARIA and event handlers onto it
via the {@link Slot } pattern.

props.name: children
props.description:
The content to portal — typically a single
{@link TooltipContentProps`Tooltip.Content`}.

props.name: container
props.description: The element to portal the content into.

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Keep the content mounted while the tooltip is closed (instead of removing
it), so a CSS exit animation on `data-state="closed"` can play.

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Keep the content mounted while the tooltip is closed (instead of removing
it), so a CSS exit animation on `data-state="closed"` can play.

props.name: onEscapeKeyDown
props.description:
Fires when `Escape` is pressed while the tooltip is open. Call
`event.preventDefault()` to keep the tooltip open; otherwise it closes.

props.name: onPointerDownOutside
props.description:
Fires on a pointer-down outside the content. Call `event.preventDefault()`
to keep the tooltip open; otherwise it closes.

contractProps.name: tone
contractProps.description: The bubble's colour treatment. `default` is a high-contrast dark bubble (inverts with the theme); `inverted` is a surface-coloured bubble for use on dark backgrounds.

contractProps.name: size
contractProps.description: Bubble size; `data-density` scales the padding within each size.

contractProps.name: placement
contractProps.description: Which side of the anchor the bubble sits on, and how it aligns — sets the CSS `position-area` and points the arrow at the anchor. Wire `anchor-name` on the trigger and a matching `position-anchor` on this bubble.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render the single child element (e.g. an `<svg>`) instead of the default
`<span>` via the {@link Slot } pattern.

elements.example:
<primitiv-tooltip>
  <primitiv-tooltip-trigger>
    <button type="button">Save</button>
  </primitiv-tooltip-trigger>
  <primitiv-tooltip-content class="primitiv-tooltip primitiv-tooltip--default primitiv-tooltip--md primitiv-tooltip--top" popover="manual">
    Saves your work
    <primitiv-tooltip-arrow class="primitiv-tooltip__arrow"></primitiv-tooltip-arrow>
  </primitiv-tooltip-content>
</primitiv-tooltip>

api.description: `<primitiv-tooltip-provider>` — optional. The tooltips inside it share one skip-delay window and its default delay, as inside React's `Tooltip.Provider`; tooltips outside any provider share a document-wide one.

attributes.name: delay-duration
attributes.description: How long, in milliseconds, a pointer rests on a trigger before its tooltip opens. Default 700. A tooltip's own `delay-duration` overrides it.

attributes.name: skip-delay-duration
attributes.description: How long, in milliseconds, after one tooltip closes that hovering another opens it at once. Default 300.

api.description:
`<primitiv-tooltip>` — the state owner of a tooltip: a short description of its trigger that appears on hover after a delay, and at once on focus. It closes when the pointer leaves (after a moment, so it can be reached), on blur, on Escape and on a press outside. Moving from one trigger to the next opens each next tooltip at once (the skip delay). The tooltip is shown as a `popover="manual"` in the top layer, with the trigger as its source, which makes the trigger its implicit anchor for CSS anchor positioning.

The root finds its own parts and reconciles their ARIA from its reflected state whenever a part arrives, leaves, or changes an attribute the root reads (the lifecycle is `PrimitivRootElement`'s).

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the tooltip is showing. Reflected: it changes as the user hovers, focuses and dismisses it. Set it (or the `open` property) to show or hide it from script.

attributes.name: delay-duration
attributes.description: How long, in milliseconds, a pointer rests on the trigger before the tooltip opens. Defaults to the provider's, or 700. Focus always opens it at once.

attributes.name: disable-hoverable-content
attributes.description: Close as soon as the pointer leaves the trigger, rather than giving it a moment to reach the tooltip.

events.name: primitiv-tooltip-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before a user-driven change is applied — hover, focus, blur, Escape or a press outside — with the open state afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

api.description: `<primitiv-tooltip-trigger>` — an interactive part. It decorates exactly one child the consumer writes, a `<button>`, which opens the tooltip on hover and focus and is described by it (`aria-describedby`), so the rendered DOM matches React's (RFC 0033 D24).

`<primitiv-tooltip-content>` — the tooltip itself. Structural: the root gives it an id, `role="tooltip"`, `popover="manual"` (write it in your markup too, so it is hidden before the script loads) and `data-state`.
`<primitiv-tooltip-arrow>` — an optional, decorative pointer, inside the content. The element writes nothing on it; style it as you like.
